summary: Incomplete answer for third-party risk assessment procedure
description: User asked in French for the complete third-party risk assessment cadence in the procurement process, including all steps, required fields, and exceptions. The assistant gave only a partial answer: quarterly cadence, supplier register, risk classification, contract approval, and basic supplier info. Feedback says the answer missed validation steps and mandatory fields. Retrieved policy chunk contained the full expected procedure: collect supplier information, classify risk, complete mandatory assessment fields, procurement committee review, acceptance/rejection decision, and document exceptions.
recommended_action: Review the response generation behavior for policy/process questions. Ensure the assistant includes all required steps and mandatory fields from the retrieved policy before answering.

summary: Incorrect citation for part-time overtime policy
description: User asked in Italian about the overtime policy for part-time employees. The assistant cited POLICY-1234, which describes overtime rules for full-time employees, not part-time employees. The expected supporting document was POLICY-5678. Feedback says the citation does not match the correct policy for part-time employees. The issue appears to involve retrieval and/or grounding because the assistant used a high-scoring but incorrect document.
recommended_action: Investigate retrieval and citation grounding for part-time vs. full-time policy queries. Improve retrieval filters or reranking so the cited document matches the employee type requested by the user.
